items.what: v2.1.331 (Nov 23, 2026) says that on or after Nov 30, 2026, plugin marketplaces listed in managed extraKnownMarketplaces will auto-update by default. It also fixes MCP tool calls hanging up to 30 minutes on some malformed server replies.
items.test: If you manage Claude Code settings for a team, decide which marketplaces should stay frozen and set "autoUpdate": false on those entries before Nov 30. Run claude doctor, which now reports whether the API can be reached.

deadlines.label: managed plugin marketplaces auto-update by default (on or after this date)

items.what: v1.0.115 (Nov 24, 2026) turns on Windows sandbox package queries by default, and an empty --available-tools value now gives the model no tools instead of every tool.
items.test: Check scripts that pass --available-tools= or --available-tools '' and expect the full tool set; they now run with none. On Windows, set sandbox.userPolicy.capabilities to [] if you want to keep package queries off.

items.what: rust-v0.172.0 (Nov 23, 2026): optional stdio MCP servers with cached tool lists now start on their first tool call by default, codex exec resume restores saved sandbox permissions and working directory, and the code_mode_host_grpc setting is deprecated.
items.test: If a script relies on an optional MCP server being up at session start, call one of its tools first or mark it required. Re-run any codex exec resume jobs that passed different sandbox flags and confirm the permissions you expect. Remove code_mode_host_grpc from config.toml.

items.what: v0.26.0 (Nov 24, 2026): Docker sandboxes now reject InContainerMountStrategy, even read-only, on create and resume, and the experimental Codex tool no longer opens a local image just because the model supplied its path.
items.test: Before upgrading, start fresh Docker sessions with a revised manifest instead of resuming old ones or old RunState. If you use the Codex tool with images, grant a named reference for each trusted image.
